home.title: Everything for your next trip, organized in one place.
home.subtitle: Plan itineraries, organize tasks, collaborate, and track expenses with your travel organizer.
home.notice: The project's foundation is ready. Features will be delivered incrementally from the MVP backlog.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address you visited doesn't exist or was moved.

tripNotFound.title: Trip unavailable
tripNotFound.description: This trip couldn't be opened. It may no longer exist, may have been deleted by the person who created it, or you may not (or no longer) have access to it.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: This page could not be loaded. You can try again or go somewhere safe.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.description: Sign in to access your private trips and planning space.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: Your trips, tasks, comments, and expenses stay private to invited participants.
signUp.name: Name

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and, if there's an account associated with it, we'll send a link to reset your password.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.

messages.check_email: Check your email to confirm your account before signing in.
messages.invalid_name: Enter a name with at least two characters.
messages.invalid_password: Use at least eight characters for your password.
messages.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
messages.signup_failed: Could not create your account. Please try again.
messages.callback_failed: The confirmation link is invalid or expired.
messages.check_email_reset: If that email exists, we sent a link to reset your password.
messages.reset_link_invalid: The reset link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
messages.password_update_failed: Could not update your password. Please try again.
messages.invalid_display_name: Enter a name with at least two characters.
messages.profile_update_failed: Could not update your profile. Please try again.

dashboard.welcomeDescription: Create a trip and keep your planning details in a private space.

editProfile.title: Edit profile
editProfile.description: This is the name shown to other participants on your trips.

reminders.title: Email reminders
reminders.description: Get a reminder when an assigned task's deadline is coming up within three days.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Choose a new password for your account.

invitations.title: Trip invitations
invitations.unavailable: This invitation is no longer available or could not be updated.
invitations.invitedAsOrganizer: You've been invited to collaborate as an organizer on this trip.

createTrip.title: Create a trip
createTrip.description: Start with the destination and dates. More planning tools will be added inside the trip.

yourTrips.title: Your trips
yourTrips.loadError: Could not load your trips. Try refreshing the page.
yourTrips.noResults: No trips found with these filters.
yourTrips.empty: No trips yet. Create your first trip above.
yourTrips.criticalOpen: {count, plural, one {# critical task open} other {# critical tasks open}}

countdown.days: {days, plural, one {# day left until the trip} other {# days left until the trip}}

errors.delete_not_allowed: Only the trip creator can delete it.
errors.cannot_remove_self: You can't remove your own access to this trip.
errors.invitation_not_allowed: Could not update that invitation. It may have already been responded to or cancelled.
errors.archive_not_allowed: Only the trip creator can archive or restore it.

trip.archivedNotice: This trip is archived. Itinerary, tasks, and expenses are read-only until it's reactivated.
trip.deleteTripDescription: This will permanently remove {destination} and all of its items, tasks, expenses, comments, and invitations.
trip.commentsLoadError: Could not load comments. The rest of the trip content is still available.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Readiness, next steps, participants, and recent trip activity.
overview.guideEmpty: No destination guide has been added yet.

itinerary.title: Itinerary
itinerary.description: Keep activities, reservations, and meeting points in chronological order.
itinerary.loadError: Could not load the itinerary. Try refreshing the page.
itinerary.deleteItemDescription: This will permanently remove "{title}" from the itinerary.
itinerary.empty: No itinerary items yet. Add the first activity above.
itinerary.reservationsDescription: Flights, lodging, and transport confirmed for this trip.
itinerary.reservationsLoadError: Could not load reservations. Try refreshing the page.
itinerary.deleteReservationDescription: This will permanently remove "{title}" from the trip's reservations.
itinerary.reservationsEmpty: No reservations yet. Add flights, lodging, or transport above.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Track shared costs and see totals broken down by currency.
expenses.loadError: Could not load expenses. Try refreshing the page.
expenses.deleteExpenseDescription: This will permanently remove "{description}" and its amount from the currency summary.
expenses.empty: No expenses yet. Add the first shared cost above.

preparation.title: Pre-trip preparation
preparation.description: Complete documents, reservations, money, health, connectivity, and packing before departure.
preparation.loadError: Could not load preparation tasks. Try refreshing the page.
preparation.deleteTaskDescription: This will permanently remove "{title}" from your preparation list.
preparation.empty: No preparation tasks match these filters. Add the England checklist or create a custom task.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Passports, vouchers, and other trip files, up to 10 MB each.
documents.loadError: Could not load documents. Try refreshing the page.
documents.deleteAttachmentDescription: This will permanently remove "{fileName}" from the trip's documents.
documents.empty: No documents uploaded yet. Upload passports, vouchers, or other files above.

organizer.title: Trip organizer
organizer.description: Invite an organizer by email. They can accept after signing in with the same address.
organizer.participantsDescription: See who has access to this trip and remove organizers when needed.
organizer.removeParticipantDescription: {name} will immediately lose access to this trip.
organizer.cancelInvitationDescription: The invitation for {email} will no longer be acceptable.
